posts.subject: Suggestions from Oxy
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,


I have few suggestions for dream servers


+ Add gloves ( Normal, Donator, Admin )
+ Add more maps that are not tight spaced
+ Fix Goron mask and Bunny ear ( bugged as owner can't see it in !tp )
+ Add coloured names in chat ( Red = Admin, Blue = Donator, Cream = Player )
+ Add tags in chat ( Owner, Leader, Co-Leader, Head-admin, Super-admin, Admin+, Admin, Test-admin, Donator+, Donator, Player )
+ Add more pets ( giraffe, Gyarados, Dragon )
+ More x2 credit events or x2 stamm events


- Paintballs as they are useless on knife
- maps that are tiny ( too much 2v1's, 3v1's etc )

Zitat von OxygeN

+ Add coloured names in chat ( Red = Admin, Blue = Donator, Cream = Player )

Noooooooo I want to keep my red name.

Zitat von Saitama

Noooooooo I want to keep my red name.

This was only suggestion It does not have to be forced in, But the Owner, Leader etc could be added

Tags like Admin and Admin + had been used, but they were removed.
The reason for that was, that Admin could join the server without being recognized/due to many Rule Breaker who suddenly started to be angels themselves but as soon the Admin would leave they would start breaking rules again.

@CyberTroniX
But tags would be seen able until admin types in chat.

+ Add gloves ( Normal, Donator, Admin )

We need custom models for that, which is hard, since we don't have anyone who can create good looking 3d models.


Zitat von OxygeN

+ Add more maps that are not tight spaced

Probably for Knife? Suggest some, then we'll see. I've been through all available knife maps on the Steam Workshop and Gamebanana twice and there are simply not a lot good maps left that aren't on the server yet.


Zitat von OxygeN

+ Fix Goron mask and Bunny ear ( bugged as owner can't see it in !tp )

Not important, you shouldn't use !tp anyways.


Zitat von OxygeN

+ Add coloured names in chat ( Red = Admin, Blue = Donator, Cream = Player )

Is already done through !store.

Zitat von OxygeN

+ Add tags in chat ( Owner, Leader, Co-Leader, Head-admin, Super-admin, Admin+, Admin, Test-admin, Donator+, Donator, Player )

As mentioned before, it would show when an admin is on the server. Also, it's basically nothing except bragging rights. You should be able to warn people without the tag in front of your name.

Zitat von OxygeN

+ Add more pets ( giraffe, Gyarados, Dragon )

Agree, has to be done. We'll look into it. Adding new pets is a tedious process and takes quite some time.


Zitat von OxygeN

+ More x2 credit events or x2 stamm events

Already being done, see here: Entschädigungsevent

Zitat von OxygeN

- Paintballs as they are useless on knife

Agreed, I will fix that soon.

Zitat von OxygeN

- maps that are tiny ( too much 2v1's, 3v1's etc )

The same thing as before, suggest maps which should be removed and we'll look into it.

Hmmmm, I believe the mask bug fix is surely of importance...


Like, imagine you were a play, both first time or long term player, it would suck playing on this server for so long to save up for 3,000 or 5,000 credits to see it not even work... I'd be personally disappointed and put off as aesthetics is has quite a big impact as to why players constantly play on our servers - they want to save up to buy expensive items in order to have bragging rights.


However, I'd really be interested to see if you can maybe introduce a plugin where if an admin joins the server, you are to go into the server without anyone knowing, join spectator straight away (still with utmost secrecy) and be able to un=hide yourself whenever. I believe that this would be essential to catch the real people who break the rules and improves effectiveness of !calladmin reports as you are able to see if they are really breaking the rules or not.


I totally agree as to bringing in more pets and items for players to purchase and farm for. But also maybe introducing more rewards again? For example, we need to award them REAL MVPs who play on a server for a long time and introduce personal rewards - such as a personal thanks from @Sky, @BlackFire, or @Nachtfrische or rewards such as crediting players who go above and beyond the Final stamm points rank etc.



Thank you for reading,
~Doo Doo

Another idea that I came up with, is there maybe a possible plugin to be immune/evade one knife attack? To be honest, it would be very cool to have this as people can evolve all sorts of new tactics from using it.


Note that it must have a cooldown, maybe there's some sort of plugin that @BlackFire can find? 😄

Like you can upgrade your skill "Luck" so the percentage to be immune to a knife hit increases?

Hmmmm yeah, something like that, but I'm afraid that if it's all about luck then the integrity of knifing would probably go down but it would definitely make the server more fun.


Maybe not an upgrade or so, just a set level for all players, like something ridiculously small like 5% or so. And it can be doubled if you have a Final Stamm point rank.


Maybe there's a plugin for this or is this not wise? @BlackFire @Nachtfrische

I got couple of suggestions:


-SwitchKnife:
Doing this command DOES NOT trade your knife to that person, the switch is temporary!
m_switchknife <target> - Sends a request to the specified player to switch knives with you!
sm_disablesk - Got a really cool knife that everybody wants, and your sick of the requests? This will automatically decline all requests sent to you.


-Smoke grenade colours
Where a player from certain amount of stamm points would be able to receive a reward of different coloured smokes


-Silent disconnect
Because when a lot of players disconnect it can sometimes get a bit spammed.


-Block the !ff
Some people spam the !ff and in chat you see a message
"Friendly Fire Disabled" which get's annoying


-Warmup round
Have a warmup round so players have enough time to connect ( 2 minutes ) ( no stamm points would be lost )


-GOTV record on ban
Whenever a client is banned, it creates a demo of the last X minutes up to the point where he's banned ( uploads to ftp and adds to sourcebans as a demo)


-Block certain words from text chat
The player would be instantly warned if he would try to say a word such as "Ni***r" or something that is highly against the rules


-Add more ingame purchases for credits
Add more pets/masks/trails for Admins, Donators and Players


-If in Dream Clan group
If a player is in Dream Clan group he would get x3 more credits


-Add some tournaments for knife server ( Can apply to other )
Make some tournaments for players so they will be able to win X amount of credits/other.


-Add custom Models on knife for Donators
They would cost X amount of credits ( Donators Only )
Very nice suggestion... I would like to see new items to buy and those N words blocked
